Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
 Heard.
 2) This appeal is directed against order dated
01.05.2013, passed by Additional District Judge/Special
Judge (E.C. Act), Dehradun, in Original Suit No. 381 of
2004, whereby said court has rejected the application for
setting aside the abatement and the application for
substitution of legal representatives of the defendant No.4
in the Suit.
 3) Learned counsel for the plaintiffs/appellants
argued that grave miscarriage of justice is caused to the
plaintiffs/appellants by rejection the application for setting
aside the abatement and substitution of legal representation
of the defendant No.4.
4) I have perused the copy of the application filed
before the trial court, which is annexed as annexure 2 to the
affidavit filed before this Court. I further perused the copy
of rejoinder affidavit filed by the plaintiffs/appellants before
the trial court, which is annexed as annexure 3 to the
affidavit filed before this Court. It has come on the record
that since the plaintiffs/appellants were not informed about
the death of the defendant No.4 by other defendants, as such
they could not move substitution application in time. There

3
is delay of only forty-five days after expiry of the period of
filing the substitution application.
5) In the above circumstances, this appeal is
allowed. Impugned order dated 01.05.2013, passed in
Original Suit No. 381 of 2004, rejecting the application
418A1, is set aside. The application for setting aside of
abatement is hereby allowed. The substitution application
moved for bringing the legal representatives of respondent
No.4 is also allowed. The plaintiffs/appellants are allowed
to make necessary amendments in the plaint, before the trial
court, within a period of 14 days, from today, whereafter,
the trial court shall proceed expeditiously, with the Suit, in
the light of order dated 15.12.2004, passed by Division
Bench of this Court, in A.O. No. 394 of 2004 (Misc.
Application No. 2118 of 2013, also stands disposed of).
